commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' 3 - 1 Goal! Ben Doak tees up Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) on the edge of the box and he fires the ball into the bottom left corner. 3:1.
90+5' The ball goes out of play and Fulham have been awarded a corner kick.
90+5' Simon Hooper couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) and blew his whistle.
90+4' Tom Cairney (Fulham) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
90+3' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Bournemouth.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.

89' Adama Traore (Fulham) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
